cohort: 400 mothers and their newborns in Porto Alegre, Brazil
finding: Newborns in the small for gestational age group had significantly lower birth weight, smaller stature, and lower cephalic perimeter compared to other groups.
mod_finding: The systemic arterial hypertension group had a higher percentage of cesarean sections compared to other groups.
birth_weight: Newborns in the small for gestational age group had significantly lower birth weight
